# Infor M3 Technical & H5 Scripting Knowledge Base
> Centralized knowledge base containing 89 Infor M3 H5 production scripts, complete TypeScript typings, and 1,311 standard M3 MI Swagger definitions.

## Key Files & Catalogs
- [README.md](README.md): Master catalog, domain tables, and retrieval guidelines
- [KB_INDEX.json](KB_INDEX.json): Machine-readable index of all 89 scripts with summaries and API usage
- [mi-swagger/MI_CATALOG.md](mi-swagger/MI_CATALOG.md): Complete directory of 1,311 standard Infor M3 MI API programs
- [api-reference/API_QUICK_REFERENCE.md](api-reference/API_QUICK_REFERENCE.md): H5 Scripting classes, interfaces, and lifecycle cheat sheet
- [docs/STANDARDS_AND_CONVENTIONS.md](docs/STANDARDS_AND_CONVENTIONS.md): Coding guidelines and required JSDoc header template
- [design-specifications/SPECS_SUMMARY.md](design-specifications/SPECS_SUMMARY.md): Summary of DES-020 technical design specifications

## Code Folders
- [scripts/finance/](scripts/finance/): Accounts Payable (APS), Accounts Receivable (ARS), Fixed Assets (FAS), General Ledger (GLS)
- [scripts/sales-and-distribution/](scripts/sales-and-distribution/): Customer (CRS), Orders (OIS), Material (MMS), Warehouse (MWS)
- [scripts/manufacturing-and-purchasing/](scripts/manufacturing-and-purchasing/): Production Orders (PMS), Purchase Orders (PPS)
- [scripts/infor-samples/](scripts/infor-samples/): Infor SDK samples demonstrating specific H5 features
- [scripts/utilities/](scripts/utilities/): Shared tools and entry mode setters
